```{r}
source("init.R")

library(ggfortify)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

wd <- set_wd()

Total <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/TotalComplet.shp"),
                     options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
Total <- transform_Total()

collision_faune_diro <- readr::read_csv(paste0(wd$data, 
                                               "raw/collision_faune_diro.csv"))
```

```{r}
Total <- Total%>%
  dplyr::filter(technique_observation == "Vu")%>%
  dplyr::select(id_synt, nom_vernaculaire, 
                date, cd_nom, cd_nom, 
                paysage_ID, paysage_nom, famille_paysage, 
                Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, bdd_originale)
Total <- Total%>%
  dplyr:: mutate(cd_nom = as.numeric(cd_nom),
                 cd_nom_grp_must = dplyr::if_else(cd_nom %in% c("60704", "60658", 
                                                       "60716", "60686", "199752",
                                                       "60674", "60731", "60746"),
                                         111, cd_nom),
                 cd_nom = as.factor(cd_nom))%>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, cd_nom_grp_must,
                paysage_ID, paysage_nom, famille_paysage, 
                etat_biologique)%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

```

```{r}
diro <- collision_faune_diro %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geom_x = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\(([^ ]+)")[,2]),
    geom_y = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\([^ ]+ ([^\\)]+)")[,2])
  )%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(geom))

diro_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(diro, 
                        coords = c("geom_x", "geom_y"), 
                        crs = 2154)
diro_sf <- sf::st_transform(diro_sf, 
                        sf::st_crs(4326))

carte_bretagne_44 <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data,                                    "masques/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale.shp"
                                        )) %>%
  sf::st_transform(2154)%>%
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(4326))

diro_conti <- sf::st_filter(diro_sf,
                            carte_bretagne_44, 
                            .predicate = sf::st_within)

diro_sf <- diro_conti%>%
  dplyr::filter(deppr != 44)

diro_sf <- diro_sf %>%
   dplyr::filter(!(espece %in% c("amphibien", "amphibiens", "autre", "autre oiseau",
                          "castor", "chat", "chauve-souris", "chien", "chouette",
                          "nr", "oiseaux sauf rapace", "rapace diurne", 
                          "rapace nocturne", "rapaces nocturnes", "rapaces diurnes",
                          "reptile", "reptiles")))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(paste(as.character(annee), mois, 01, sep="-")),
                espece = dplyr::if_else(commentaire == "Furet", 
                          "furet", espece, missing=espece))%>% 
  dplyr::mutate(bdd_originale = "DIRO",
                etat_biologique = "Trouvé mort : impact routier")%>%
  dplyr::mutate(espece = as.factor(espece)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-date_maj, -annee, -mois, -commentaire, -grp_espece)

diro_sf <- diro_sf%>%
  dplyr::mutate(cd_nom = dplyr::case_when(
    espece == "blaireau" ~ 60636,
    espece == "cerf/biche" ~ 61000,
    espece == "chevreuil" ~ 61057,
    espece == "écureuil" ~ 61153,
    espece == "hérisson" ~ 60015,
    espece == "lapin" ~ 61714,
    espece == "lièvre" ~ 61678,
    espece == "loutre" ~ 60630,
    espece == "mustélidé" ~ 111,
    espece == "ragondin" ~ 61667,
    espece == "rat" ~ NA,
    espece == "rat musqué" ~ 61448,
    espece == "renard" ~ 60658,
    espece == "sanglier" ~ 60981,
    espece == "martre" ~ 60658, 
    espece == "furet" ~ 199752, 
    espece == "vison d'amérique" ~ 60746, 
    espece == "belette" ~ 60716, 
    espece == "fouine" ~ 60674, 
    espece == "hermine" ~ 60686, 
    espece == "putois" ~ 60731, 
    .default = NA
  ),
  cd_nom_grp_must = dplyr::case_when(
    cd_nom %in% c("60704", "60658", "60716", "60686", "199752","60674", "60731",
                  "60746"), 111, cd_nom
    )
  )%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cd_nom))%>%
  dplyr::select(cd_nom, cd_nom_grp_must, espece, date, geom, geometry, etat_biologique)


diro_sf <- diro_sf%>%
  ajout_famille_paysage() %>%
  ajout_10x10_predetermine()%>%
  dplyr::rename(Code_10km = CODE_10KM)%>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, X_10km, Y_10km, 
                date, cd_nom, cd_nom_grp_must,
                paysage_ID, paysage_nom, famille_paysage,
                etat_biologique)

diro <- diro_sf%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()
```
```{r}
MortsTotal <- rbind(MortsNat, diro)
```
